The $[0,+\infty)\times(0,+\infty)^2\times(\mathbb{R}^n)^H$ function $(\delta, \alpha, \mu, \mathbf{O}_1,\ldots,\mathbf{O}_H)\mapsto \lambda_H(\delta, \alpha, \mu, \mathbf{O}_1,\ldots,\mathbf{O}_H)$ is continuous in , and concave with respect to $(\delta, \alpha, \mu) \in [0,+\infty)\times(0,+\infty)^2$ . all $\delta\geq 0$ , or $\lambda_H(\delta, \alpha, \mu, \mathbf{O}_1,\ldots,\mathbf{O}_H)$ is increasing with respect to $\delta\geq 0$ .
